scope: All 350 system identifiers and supplied partial-model structures inspected. Shared mechanism-recovery protocol reviewed; individual biological identities, hidden mechanisms and observed-data adaptations remain unresolved. Source subset names are metadata, not training difficulty labels.
enumeration: Initial ID inventory projected folder_name only. A subsequent bounded structural audit projected folder_name and partial, parsed every supplied XML model and retained counts/hashes only. truth_sedml and truth_xml columns were not projected, inspected or used for authoring. No evaluation-run traces or raw source models are vendored.

license_and_lineage: No explicit dataset license was found in the inspected card metadata. Reuse remains unresolved. No reference models, benchmark prompts, answers or biological fixtures are vendored. Source observations are simulated from curated models; an adaptation must use independent observed biological data to enter final training.

evaluation_run_count.interpretation: Repeated model-run records are not distinct tasks. Counts are from the paper and public dataset schema, not a downloaded trace inventory.

source_grading.inspection: Public prompts, question/experiment interfaces, example configuration and evaluator implementation inspected. No execution; simulator and SBML implementation details remain unreviewed.
default_metrics: Added-reaction reactant/product and reactant/product/modifier set precision, recall and F1

static_code_findings.finding: Reaction matching hashes sets of species IDs by role. It ignores stoichiometric coefficients, repeated reactions, reversibility and kinetic laws; exact role-set recovery is not complete chemical recovery.
Uses mean abs(a-b)/(abs(a)+abs(b)), without a factor of two or 100; zero/zero contributes zero and mismatched shapes return one. Explicit finite-value checks are needed for adaptation.
Appends only keys present in each dictionary. Contrary to its zero-fill comment, missing species are not aligned or filled; equal-sized mismatched species sets can be compared positionally.
Computes a perturbed true_traj but scores the perturbed prediction against self.true_traj, the unperturbed trajectory. This static finding has not been reproduced by execution.
Simulation exceptions skip trials, and an empty successful-trial list yields zero mean/min/max error. A new verifier must require completed trials and reject failed simulations.

adaptation_requirements: Match species identities, units and time grids before numerical comparison.
Score each intervention against its matching reference and report completed-trial counts.
Freeze intervention seeds and simulator versions; reject nonfinite or failed outputs.
Separate reaction topology, kinetics and predictive performance; trajectory agreement does not establish a unique mechanism.

task_defaults.assessment: Identifier enumerated; shared protocol reviewed; individual system input and endpoint uninspected.

iterative-mechanism-recovery.scientific_decision: Compare candidate mechanisms using designed interventions and prediction of system dynamics.
required_stages: inspect an incomplete SBML model and declared simulation settings
choose permitted observations or initial-concentration interventions
analyze resulting species time courses and simulate candidate models
revise missing mechanisms and submit a complete SBML model
evaluate structural recovery and predictive agreement under defined conditions
scientific_constraints: The prompt forbids changes to boundary/constant species.
A fitted trajectory can be compatible with multiple mechanisms; do not equate fit with unique causal recovery.
The public source uses simulated measurements. Observed perturbation/time-course data are required for a real-data training adaptation.
remaining_gaps: Review each system-specific scientific endpoint before assigning coverage; 350 identifiers share one inspected protocol.
Resolve data rights and obtain independent observed time courses with intervention, units and replicate metadata.
Specify and validate an offline connected workflow within 30 minutes, with input-reading oracle and complete artifact checks.
Correct the recorded scorer limitations in any independent verifier; the upstream scorer has not been executed here.

input_structure_review.method: Streaming PyArrow batches of 8, columns folder_name and partial, then standard-library XML element/attribute counts. This is not libSBML semantic validation or simulation.
input_structure_review.limitation: Partial models have no biological names, annotations or notes. Their structural metadata cannot identify missing reactions or prove that one observed-data adaptation covers a source system.
